record_title: Cayley root geometry and an exact companion discriminant for two Chebyshev-like polynomial families
provenance: Zero-geometric and discriminant refinement of the reciprocal polynomial families introduced by Dilcher, Kim and Stolarsky in arXiv:2607.16940.
limitations: The Apollonius regions are inclusion bounds and are not claimed optimal. The Cauchy-law result is weak convergence and does not give an optimal discrepancy rate after the unbounded Cayley pushforward. The exact companion discriminant is a specialization obtained with classical discriminant covariance, so older general resultant formulas remain a residual originality risk; the direct 2026 source is also recent. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
